title: Jalen Duren Misses Second Half Of Pistons Victory Due To Right Thigh Injury
text:
Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren did not play in the second half of his team's victory at the Miami Heat on Friday. Duren was deemed questionable to return due to a right thigh injury, and did not play after halftime. Paul Reed started in place of Duren and finished the game for Detroit. 
 The Pistons next play on Sunday at the Philadelphia 76ers. It's unknown at this point what Duren's status
summary: Duren was held out after halftime of Detroit's win at Miami with a right thigh issue, was listed questionable to return, and his availability for Sunday's game at Philadelphia is unclear.
